info.title: 11 Estates CRM — intake service
info.description:
Intake (S1, HLD §2): uploads, strict/mapping modes, templates, validation, classification, review queue, free-text parse. Conventions: docs/04-lld/conventions.md. LLD: docs/04-lld/intake.md.
All staff routes are reached through web (one hop). Extensions on every operation: x-roles, x-rate-limit, x-timeout-ms, x-idempotency, x-emits, x-paginated.

servers.description: Vercel project intake (bom1); called by web and pg_cron only

post.summary: Create an upload and get a signed storage URL
post.description: Validates name, type and size (≤ 50 MB). Anonymise defaults to true in pilot mode (CR-006 Z-9); anonymise=false in pilot → 409 anonymise-required.

201.description: Created. The browser PUTs the file to uploadUrl, then calls /inspect.

post.x-rate-limit: 5 uploads/hour per user (conventions §4), plus 20 req/s per user on reads
post.x-idempotency: Idempotency-Key (24 h, per user+route); replay returns the original status and body; same key + different body → 409 idempotency-key-reused.

get.x-rate-limit: 20 req/s per user, burst 40 (enforced at web, conventions §4)

get.summary: Get an upload (status, mode, counts, suggested mapping)
get.x-rate-limit: 20 req/s per user, burst 40 (enforced at web, conventions §4)

patch.summary: Change pre-start options (anonymise switch, source detail, sheet)
patch.description: Only the uploader, Admin or Manager. 409 upload-not-editable after start; 409 anonymise-required when turning anonymise off in pilot mode.
patch.x-rate-limit: 20 req/s per user, burst 40 (enforced at web, conventions §4)
patch.x-idempotency: JSON Merge Patch, idempotent by design; If-Match: <version> → 412 version-mismatch on mismatch.

post.summary: Confirm the file is in storage and inspect it asynchronously
post.description: Checks the storage object exists and matches sizeBytes, then enqueues q_intake_inspect: sheet list, header row, sha256, strict/mapping detection (D-15), migration_map sheet detection, suggested mapping, duplicate detection. 409 file-missing if the object is not in storage.
post.x-rate-limit: 20 req/s per user, burst 40 (enforced at web, conventions §4)
post.x-idempotency: Naturally idempotent: a repeat while inspecting or after inspection returns the current upload (202/200); Idempotency-Key also honoured.

put.summary: Set the column mapping (mapping mode) and optionally save it as a template
put.description: Allowed in awaiting_mapping or ready. Every required target (record_scope or a constant, and at least one of raw_text / property_type / deal_type) must be mapped; each target may be used once. In strict mode 409 mapping-not-allowed.
put.x-rate-limit: 20 req/s per user, burst 40 (enforced at web, conventions §4)
put.x-idempotency: Full replacement, idempotent by design; If-Match: <version> optional.

post.description: Pins the active vocabulary version, fixes chunk size (500 pilot / 2,000 paid) and enqueues the split job. 409 upload-not-ready (not inspected or mapping missing), 409 duplicate-upload (identical file already processed; send allowDuplicate=true), 409 vocabulary-unavailable.

202.description: Queued; upload.started.v1 is emitted when splitting begins

post.x-rate-limit: 20 req/s per user, burst 40 (enforced at web, conventions §4)
post.x-idempotency: Idempotency-Key (24 h, per user+route); replay returns the original status and body; same key + different body → 409 idempotency-key-reused.

post.summary: Cancel an upload that has not completed
post.description: Stops queued chunks. Batches already emitted stay applied in records (re-upload is idempotent). Emits upload.failed.v1 (reason cancelled) if processing had started. Uploader, Admin or Manager only.
post.x-rate-limit: 20 req/s per user, burst 40 (enforced at web, conventions §4)
post.x-idempotency: Idempotency-Key (24 h, per user+route); replay returns the original status and body; same key + different body → 409 idempotency-key-reused.

get.x-rate-limit: 20 req/s per user, burst 40 (enforced at web, conventions §4)

get.summary: Row errors (rejected rows) with field, code and non-PII value
get.x-rate-limit: 20 req/s per user, burst 40 (enforced at web, conventions §4)

get.summary: Signed link to download the rejected rows file (CSV, original values)
get.description: Uploader, Admin, Manager or Data operator only (re-checked). 409 rejected-file-not-ready until the upload completes. The file itself is built by the finalize job; it holds the original cells (anonymised when the switch was on) plus an error column.
get.x-rate-limit: 20 req/s per user, burst 40 (enforced at web, conventions §4)
get.x-idempotency: Safe; each call mints a new short-lived link and records one audit entry (file contains contact PII).

get.x-rate-limit: 20 req/s per user, burst 40 (enforced at web, conventions §4)

parameters.name: headerFingerprint
parameters.description: Find the template for a header set

get.x-rate-limit: 20 req/s per user, burst 40 (enforced at web, conventions §4)

post.x-rate-limit: 20 req/s per user, burst 40 (enforced at web, conventions §4)
post.x-idempotency: Idempotency-Key (24 h, per user+route); replay returns the original status and body; same key + different body → 409 idempotency-key-reused.

get.x-rate-limit: 20 req/s per user, burst 40 (enforced at web, conventions §4)

put.x-rate-limit: 20 req/s per user, burst 40 (enforced at web, conventions §4)
put.x-idempotency: Full replacement, idempotent by design; If-Match: <version> → 412 version-mismatch.

delete.x-rate-limit: 20 req/s per user, burst 40 (enforced at web, conventions §4)
delete.x-idempotency: Idempotent: deleting an already-deleted item returns 204.

get.summary: Classification review queue, filterable by reason code

schema.description: Reason code derived for grouping (PRD US-07a AC5). Matches rows.classified.v1 reviewReasonCode.
Finer intake-side cause (stored; not in the event).

200.description: Page of review items, oldest first within the group

get.x-rate-limit: 20 req/s per user, burst 40 (enforced at web, conventions §4)

get.summary: Open review items grouped by reason code (C-05 group headers)
get.x-rate-limit: 20 req/s per user, burst 40 (enforced at web, conventions §4)

get.summary: Get one review item with redacted context
get.x-rate-limit: 20 req/s per user, burst 40 (enforced at web, conventions §4)

post.summary: Resolve a review item (set / confirm / skip)
post.description: Values are validated against the upload's pinned vocabulary version (scope → deal_type, segment → property_type, market only with Sale). set/confirm/discard emit review_item.resolved.v1 (with uploadId and action); skip emits nothing. 409 review-item-closed if already resolved.
post.x-rate-limit: 20 req/s per user, burst 40 (enforced at web, conventions §4)
post.x-idempotency: Idempotency-Key (24 h, per user+route); replay returns the original status and body; same key + different body → 409 idempotency-key-reused.

post.summary: Resolve up to 100 review items with one classification (e.g. accept defaulted side)
post.description: One event per resolved item. Items already closed are reported in failed[] with review-item-closed.
post.x-rate-limit: 20 req/s per user, burst 40 (enforced at web, conventions §4)
post.x-idempotency: Idempotency-Key (24 h, per user+route); replay returns the original status and body; same key + different body → 409 idempotency-key-reused.

post.summary: Parse typed free text into a suggested classification (quick add prefill)
post.description: Rules first; only text that rules cannot classify is redacted (phones, emails, names near contact phrases, unit numbers → placeholders) and sent to the Hugging Face model (ADR-0004). The text is never persisted or logged.
post.x-rate-limit: 30 req/min per user (bounds model spend; conventions §4 default otherwise)
post.x-timeout-justification: Approved exception R-5 (conventions §10): rules (~50 ms) + one redacted model call capped at 2 s, no retry; web uses a 4 s per-route timeout.
post.x-idempotency: Stateless and side-effect free; Idempotency-Key not required (nothing is stored).

get.summary: Rows of one emitted batch, with PII and raw text (records ingestion)
get.description: Service token minted by web (R-2, POST /internal/v1/service-tokens; verified against web JWKS) with aud=intake, sub=records and the tenant's tid. Response is never cached or logged. 404 batch-not-found if the batch was not emitted (or raw rows were purged).
get.x-rate-limit: records drainers only (≤ 8 concurrent); no user limit

get.summary: The crm_notes text of one upload row (journeys note import, CR-012)
get.description: Service token minted by web (R-2) with aud=intake, sub=journeys. The note may contain PII; the response is never cached or logged. 404 not-found when the row has no note or raw rows were purged (retention).
get.x-rate-limit: journeys drainers only; no user limit

get.summary: Migration map entries for records to apply before any batch of this upload
get.x-rate-limit: records drainers only; no user limit

post.summary: Relay unpublished outbox rows to consumer pgmq queues
post.description: Reads up to 5,000 outbox rows where published_at is null and enqueues one copy per subscribed consumer queue (subscriptions from contracts/asyncapi/events.yaml).
post.x-rate-limit: n/a: pg_cron/pg_net only (1 call/min per job plus pokes)
post.x-timeout-justification: Background work, not on a request path: function max duration 60 s pilot; chunk drains up to 300 s on Pro (capacity plan §2).
post.x-idempotency: Safe to repeat: rows are claimed with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and marked published_at in the same transaction; consumers dedupe on eventId.

post.summary: Drain one of this service's pgmq queues
post.x-rate-limit: n/a: pg_cron/pg_net only (1 call/min per job plus pokes)
post.x-timeout-justification: Background work, not on a request path: function max duration 60 s pilot; chunk drains up to 300 s on Pro (capacity plan §2).
post.x-idempotency: Safe to repeat: messages are read with a visibility timeout; handlers dedupe on eventId (processed_events) or on their own work key; after 5 failed reads a message moves to <queue>_dlq.
x-callers: self re-poke while the queue is non-empty (pg_net)

post.x-rate-limit: n/a: pg_cron/pg_net only (1 call/min per job plus pokes)
post.x-timeout-justification: Background work, not on a request path: function max duration 60 s pilot; chunk drains up to 300 s on Pro (capacity plan §2).
post.x-idempotency: Jobs are idempotent: each works from persisted state and a per-job advisory lock prevents overlapping runs (a second call returns 409 conflict).

get.summary: Readiness (DB reachable, migrations at expected version)

staffViaWeb.description: Service token minted by web for a signed-in staff user (aud=<service>, sub=web, tid, 5 min), plus headers X-User-Id, X-User-Role, X-Tenant-Id. Services re-check role and tenant.

serviceToken.description: Service-to-service JWT (aud=<service>, sub=<caller>, tid, 5 min). Issued by web at POST /internal/v1/service-tokens; verify with web GET /.well-known/jwks.json (conventions R-2). Internal routes only.

cronSecret.name: X-Cron-Secret
cronSecret.description: Per-service secret used by Supabase pg_cron/pg_net for /internal/v1/relay, /internal/v1/drain/*, /internal/v1/jobs/*.

Classification.description: Classification in BRD §4.2 order. Blank = null (never 'Unknown').

unchanged.description: Rows skipped because externalRef + contentHash were already ingested

importCrmNotes.description: One-time initial import: carry crm_notes as a note (CR-006 Z-8)

header.description: Column headers as read (no cell values)

suggestedMapping.description: sourceHeader → target field (mapping mode). Never contains cell values.

anonymise.description: Default true while the tenant is in pilot mode; false is refused with 409 anonymise-required until the paid-plan gate.

uploadUrl.description: Supabase Storage signed upload URL (PUT), bucket intake-uploads, single use

UploadPatch.description: Allowed only before start (status awaiting_file…ready); otherwise 409 upload-not-editable.

columnMap.description: sourceHeader → target field (Appendix C snake_case name) or null to ignore

reprocessUnchanged.description: Re-emit rows whose externalRef + contentHash were already ingested (recovery after a records DLQ incident). Admin/Manager only.

severity.description: error = row rejected; warning = row loaded, value dropped

value.description: Offending value; null when the field is a PII field

reasonCode.description: Reason code derived for grouping (PRD US-07a AC5). Matches rows.classified.v1 reviewReasonCode.

detailCode.description: Finer intake-side cause (stored; not in the event).

reasonCode.description: Reason code derived for grouping (PRD US-07a AC5). Matches rows.classified.v1 reviewReasonCode.

action.description: set = apply the given classification; confirm = accept current values; discard = the row is not a real record (records voids it); skip = defer (stays visible, no event)

phones.description: E.164, extracted by rules from the caller's own text; returned to the caller only, never stored or logged

modelUnavailable.description: true when the model was skipped (credits, timeout, breaker open): rules-only result

oneOf.description: Reason code derived for grouping (PRD US-07a AC5). Matches rows.classified.v1 reviewReasonCode.

buildingName.description: Upload column building_name (CR-012). Private: dedup and proposals only, never public, redacted before any AI call.

floor.description: Upload column floor (CR-012). PII-sensitive (conventions §9): never public.

hasCrmNotes.description: The row carried a non-empty crm_notes value (CR-012). The text is served only by the note endpoint.

crmNotes.description: PII; present only when the upload has importCrmNotes = true

IntakeRow.description: One normalised row in the Appendix C field set (camelCase). lead_status and follow_up_date are never included (CR-006 Z-8).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: UUID; 24 h replay window per user+route. Same key with a different body → 409 idempotency-key-reused.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Row version for optimistic concurrency; mismatch → 412 version-mismatch.
